Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Oliver
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 118 as introduced would exempt volunteer rescue squads from the payment of license and registration fees and ad valorem taxes for utility trailers beginning January 1, 2022. This bill would reduce receipts, cumulatively, to the Public School Fund, the State General Fund, the Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund and county and municipal funds by an estimated $1,400 annually, based on information provided by the Alabama Association of Rescue Squads.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 118 as passed the House of Representatives would exempt volunteer rescue squads from the payment of license and registration fees and ad valorem taxes for utility trailers beginning January 1, 2022. This bill would reduce receipts, cumulatively, to the Public School Fund, the State General Fund, the Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund and county and municipal funds by an estimated $1,400 annually, based on information provided by the Alabama Association of Rescue Squads.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Hall
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/07/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 306 as amended and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, upon approval of the Legislature, by $25,000 for each year of wrongfully incarceration of an individual that meets the criteria provided in the bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
